grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Present perfect progressive with for and since
grammarPoints.rule: Use have or has + been + verb-ing to talk about an action that started in the past and is still going on now. Use for with a length of time and since with the moment it started.
grammarPoints.pattern: subject + have / has + been + verb-ing + for / since + time

chart.title: Present perfect progressive with for and since

chart.note_rule: The present perfect progressive stresses that the action is still going on and has lasted a while.
chart.note_exception: Use for with a length of time and since with the point it began — the same rule as the present perfect.
chart.note_exception_detail: Contract it in speech: I've been, she's been, they've been. The negative is haven't been / hasn't been + verb-ing.

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Whatever, whenever, wherever, whoever
grammarPoints.rule: Add -ever to what, when, where and who to mean “it does not matter which thing, time, place or person”.
grammarPoints.pattern: whatever / whenever / wherever / whoever + subject + verb

chart.title: Whatever, whenever, wherever, whoever

intro_examples.text: Do whatever you can to save water.
intro_examples.jp: 水を節約するためにできることは何でもしましょう。

intro_examples.text: Save fresh water whenever you can and wherever you go.
intro_examples.jp: できるときはいつでも、行く先どこでも淡水を節約しましょう。

intro_examples.text: Whoever threw paint down the drain is in trouble!
intro_examples.jp: 排水口にペンキを流した人はだれであれ困ったことになります！

rows.example: Whoever threw paint down the drain is in trouble!

rows.example: Whoever uses the dishwasher should fill it first.
rows.jp: 食器洗い機を使う人はだれであれ、まずいっぱいにすべきです。

chart.note_rule: These words join two ideas into one sentence and mean “no matter which / when / where / who”.
chart.note_exception: Whoever can be the subject of the sentence, so the verb after it is singular: Whoever wants water needs to save it.
chart.note_exception_detail: Do not add a second question word: say Do whatever you can, not Do whatever what you can.
